description:
Freedom Technology Solutions Group has an exciting opportunity for a Software Engineer  in a team-based Agile environment located in VA!

 Responsibilities: 

 
 Provide full software build to include front and back-end system and sub-system

 Use Agile methodologies to include user stories and requirements backlog captured in an enterprise provided tool and managed in no more than 2–3-week sprints. 

 Responsible for the coordination of all activities required to complete each story.

 Perform development activities in accordance with the customers regulations and policies to include but not limited to delivering work in increments during each sprint, with regular demonstrations and feedback sessions to validate progress.

 Apply knowledge of usability and accessibility standards, user research, and user-centered design principles to optimize application interface designs.

 Perform development activities in accordance with the customers regulations regarding accessibility standards for Information Technology as codified by the Accessibility Standards and Accessibility Test Criteria.

 Create, update and maintain engineering and support documentation, as approved by the customer, for assigned projects and programs for the lifespan of all projects and services.

 Monitor and take responsive actions on application and support environment level alarms and audit

 Assess mission partner requirements, identify dependencies, gaps, and develop responsive project plans approved by the customer.

 Support other software development functions as required by the customer.

 
 Required Qualifications: 

 
 Active security clearance with polygraph.

 Bachelor's degree in a related field.

  

 What’s in It for You? 

 Flexible work environment

 A team mentality – work with friendly, like-minded professionals

 Work with innovative, cutting edge technologies

 Enjoy extremely competitive compensation and benefits

 A work-life balance you can count on

 Opportunities to grow and advance your career on our dime

  

 The Benefits You Get with Freedom 

 Amazing benefits including matching 401k, fully paid medical, and more

 Generous paid time off – including paid site closure days

 Competitive salary offerings

 Paid training and tuition reimbursement

 Referral bonuses

 Fully paid life and disability

 Annual logo wear allowance

 Company sponsored events (game nights, holiday party, summer party, happy hours)

 Interested in learning more about Freedom and our culture?  Contact us today!  We’re constantly hosting hiring events in our office and elsewhere, to help you get a sense of what life is like at Freedom before joining the team.

  

 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, marital status, disability or veteran status
